items.q: And, and with this guy on banjo, Jack Dick Armstrong, if you have it, it's easy, it makes it so easy for you to play.

ctx.x: PT. It's almost like listening to the real thing, don't you hear them? Yes. That, they have, have a lot, very, very, they have a lot of great help. And, and with this guy on banjo, Jack Dick Armstrong, if you have it, it's easy, it makes it so easy for you to play. Yeah. You know, you know, you've got solid rhythm, correct chords, and you don't have to worry.
You know, he's come a long way on banjo, when he first started, he was draggy.
